raw_evidence_sections.heading: The requirements to study at the NIT
raw_evidence_sections.text: We accept applications from outstanding international and German students, in particular students must have: For the Double Degree : Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Natural Science, Information or Computer Science For the Single Degree : Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Natural Science, Information or Computer Science or in a business related field Good grades (in the upper third to quarter) Proven record of personal and academic achievement High level of proficiency in English

raw_evidence_sections.heading: Initial professional experience is a plus but not a requirement for admission

raw_evidence_sections.heading: Take the next step in your career! The NIT Master’s Program (MBA/M.A.) in Technology Management prepares you for responsible leadership and management tasks. Th
raw_evidence_sections.text: Together with fellow students you will learn to plan and implement complex projects and innovative ideas independently. Our international community of students and lecturers creates an intercultural atmosphere in which individual learning is made possible through freedom and intensive learning support. Flexible studies – alongside your doctorate or career!

raw_evidence_sections.heading: You decide whether you complete our Master's program with 90 or 120 ECTS . Depending on your previous studies and your personal goals and requirements, you can
raw_evidence_sections.text: For a Master's degree with 120 ECTS you will participate in additional modules (complementary modules) and thus collect additional credit points. The 120 ECTS study option is particularly attractive for foreign students who wish to apply for a student visa for Germany. YOUR MBA/M.A. IN 24 MONTHS: OVERVIEW 24 months including Master Thesis and internship Recommended course of studies: Master/MBA, 90 ECTS part-time: Volume approx. 30 hours/week = 3 semesters + 1 semester for the thesis Master/MBA, 120 ECTS part-time: Volume approx. 30 hours/week = 3 semesters + 1 semester for the thesis Master/MBA, 120 ECTS full-time: Volume approx. 40 hours/week = 3 semesters + 1 semester for the thesis 25 to 35 students Start of study program October 2025 Start of German-language course September 2025 Application period October 1, 2024 until September 15, 2025 > learn how to apply here Master of Business Administration (MBA) Master of Arts (Work experience < 1 years) Degree conferred by Hamburg University of Technology (TUHH) 90 or 120 ECTS FIBAA Master 90 ECTS: 26,750 € + 150 € Master 120 ECTS: + 9.750 EUR A practical and project-oriented learning concept that promotes future-oriented competencies International and intercultural community
